key_toilets.name: Conveniences Key
key_toilets.description: Castle Museum. A brass tag reads CONVENIENCES. The tag is worn smooth on one side and new on the other.

key_maintenance.name: Maintenance Key
key_maintenance.description: Opens the maintenance room off the cloakroom. The wooden fob lists the hours the power is checked: nine, one and four.

key_floor.name: Floor Key No. 3
key_floor.description: Opens the SCIENCE wing. Stamped FLOOR KEY No. 3. Nobody at the desk could say what one and two open.

key_attendant.name: The Attendant's Key
key_attendant.description: One key on a ring that held eleven. It opens the wing that is not on the plan.

key_forest.name: Forest Gate Key
key_forest.description: A council key on a green tag: BUTTERFLY FOREST, GATE. Visitors are counted in and counted out.
